use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES
use System.Math

use Point = (x: double, y: double, z: double)
use Colour = (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte)

let size = 300
let tilt = 0.45D

plus(a: Point, b: Point) -> Point =>
    (x = a.x + b.x, y = a.y + b.y, z = a.z + b.z)

times(p: Point, k: double) -> Point =>
    (x = p.x * k, y = p.y * k, z = p.z * k)

rgb(r: int, g: int, b: int) -> Colour =>
    (red = cast ubyte(r), green = cast ubyte(g), blue = cast ubyte(b))

let x_axis: Point = (x = 1.0D, y = 0.0D, z = 0.0D)
let y_axis: Point = (x = 0.0D, y = 1.0D, z = 0.0D)
let z_axis: Point = (x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D, z = 1.0D)

let faces: (normal: Point, u: Point, v: Point, colour: Colour)[] = [
    (y_axis, x_axis, z_axis, rgb(245, 245, 245)),
    (times(y_axis, -1.0D), x_axis, z_axis, rgb(255, 213, 0)),
    (z_axis, x_axis, y_axis, rgb(0, 155, 72)),
    (times(z_axis, -1.0D), x_axis, y_axis, rgb(0, 70, 173)),
    (x_axis, y_axis, z_axis, rgb(183, 18, 52)),
    (times(x_axis, -1.0D), y_axis, z_axis, rgb(255, 88, 0))
]

turned(p: Point, angle: double) -> Point is
    let x = p.x * Math.cos(angle) + p.z * Math.sin(angle)
    let z = p.z * Math.cos(angle) - p.x * Math.sin(angle)

    (
        x = x,
        y = p.y * Math.cos(tilt) - z * Math.sin(tilt),
        z = p.y * Math.sin(tilt) + z * Math.cos(tilt))
si

square(
    centre: Point, u: Point, v: Point, half: double, angle: double
) -> Collections.List[(x: double, y: double)] =>
    [(-1.0D, -1.0D), (1.0D, -1.0D), (1.0D, 1.0D), (-1.0D, 1.0D)]
        |> map(((a, b)) =>
            turned(
                plus(centre, plus(times(u, a * half), times(v, b * half))),
                angle))
        |> map(p => (x = p.x, y = p.y))
        |> collect_list()

draw(image: IMAGE, angle: double) is
    image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 247ub)

    let body = SHAPES()
    let stickers = SHAPES()

    for face in faces do
        if turned(face.normal, angle).z > 0.0D then
            let centre = times(face.normal, 1.5D)

            let outline = square(centre, face.u, face.v, 1.5D, angle)

            body.add(outline, 20ub, 20ub, 20ub)

            for i in -1::1 do
                for j in -1::1 do
                    let at = plus(
                        centre,
                        plus(
                            times(face.u, cast double(i)),
                            times(face.v, cast double(j))))

                    stickers.add(
                        square(at, face.u, face.v, 0.42D, angle),
                        face.colour)
                od
            od
        fi
    od

    image.fill(body)
    image.fill(stickers)
si

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

image.view(-2.8D, -2.8D, 2.8D, 2.8D)

draw(image, -Math.pi / 5.0D)

write_line("a solved cube, white on top, green facing, red to the right")

image.write("rubik.png")

image.show("rubik.png")
